title: Closed substacks and projection-compatible scheme base changes
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], and use the categories over $\mathit{Sch}/S$, discrete representable fibred groupoids, functors over the base, 2-isomorphisms and 2-fibre products of [def-sfb-stable-pointed-moduli-groupoids]. For a functor $f:\mathcal F\to\mathcal G$ and $t:h_T\to\mathcal G$, a scheme $Z/S$ with $j:Z\to T$ represents its scheme base change if there is an equivalence $h_Z\simeq h_T\times_{\mathcal G}\mathcal F$ over $\mathit{Sch}/S$ whose first projection is 2-isomorphic to $h_j$, i.e. a scheme presentation of that 2-base change with projection $j$ in the sense of [def-sfb-moduli-chart-normalization]. For a category fibred in groupoids $\mathcal F$, a closed substack is specified by a predicate $P$ on its objects, stable under every pullback, whose strictly full subcategory $\mathcal F_P$ is an etale stack and such that for every $t:h_T\to\mathcal F$ its scheme base change is represented in the preceding sense by a closed immersion $j:Z\to T$ [def-weil-closed-immersion]. The full category and its inclusion use the general full-subcategory constructions of [def-sfb-open-moduli-substack]. Its category has the original projection to schemes, and its inclusion is the actual full inclusion. No atlas or algebraicity of $\mathcal F_P$ is assumed as additional data.
